text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't change any tests. These are the fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`), so it now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5. The comment above it and the tests both say five.
- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books` was missing a third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copies are my choice. Austen and 1815 match the data in `test_search.py`.
